name: Ricardo Campos
bio:
Ricardo Campos is a seasoned quality control expert with over 25 years of experience ensuring the highest standards in motorsport engineering. Born and raised in Santiago, Chile, Ricardo's passion for racing ignited during his youth, spending countless hours at local karting events. After earning his degree in mechanical engineering, he quickly transitioned into the world of competitive racing, starting as a junior technician before specializing in quality assurance. 

Ricardo's meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to precision have earned him a reputation for identifying and resolving even the most subtle flaws in vehicle design and construction. He believes in a proactive approach, emphasizing preventative measures and continuous improvement to minimize risks and maximize performance. Known for his methodical nature and sharp eye for detail, Ricardo is eager to contribute his expertise to a team striving for excellence.

What distinguishes Ricardo is his expertise in non-destructive testing techniques, which he applies rigorously to ensure the integrity of critical components. He consistently seeks innovative solutions to optimize testing processes and improve the overall reliability of racing vehicles.

physical.description: A man of average height with a sturdy build, Ricardo carries himself with a confident, observant demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of magnifying glass for close inspections.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
